subject: RE: Renewal paperwork + incremental capacity top-up / invoice split
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Huang <lisa.huang@averytech.com>
Cc: priyom.das@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal paperwork + incremental capacity top-up / invoice split

Hi Lisa —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our call, AveryTech is set to renew the Azure private offer on 2027-01-01, and you mentioned wanting to accelerate an incremental capacity top-up to cover a holiday campaign spike.

Summary of what Redwood understands you need: 
- 18-month renewal term starting 2027-01-01 (you requested alignment with fiscal cycles)
- +20% committed capacity for Q1 2027 as a temporary top-up (auto-reverts to baseline in month 4)
- Split invoicing: 60% at renewal effective date, 40% invoiced as a separate tranche in 90 days (for your FY timing)

Next steps we propose (can be adjusted):
1) We draft an amendment to the existing private offer that encodes the 18-month term + top-up and tranche schedule.
2) You confirm PO routing and whether procurement will sign the amendment or prefer a separate PO for the top-up tranche.
3) We generate the DocuSign + AWS Private Offer change request and share the HubSpot deal link for tracking.

If procurement prefers, we can accept a single PO and produce two invoices internally; if they require two POs we can accommodate that as well.

Please confirm who from AveryTech procurement will sign and the billing email for invoices. I can get legal and finance looped in on our side once you confirm.

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0143

Attachments: none yet
From: Lisa Huang <lisa.huang@averytech.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@averytech.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork + incremental capacity top-up / invoice split

Thanks Tessa — this matches our notes. A few clarifying items from procurement: 

- We prefer two separate POs (one for the baseline 18mo commitment, one for the Q1 top-up) so our internal ledgers can map to two cost centers.
- Tranche timing: PO-1 (baseline) should be dated 2027-01-01; PO-2 (top-up) can be dated 2027-03-31 and charged immediately upon receipt.
- Billing email: invoices@averytech.com (AP team will receive PDF invoices).
- Do you have a standard amendment template for Azure Private Offers or should we expect a DocuSign with terms to sign?

Also, legal asked whether Redwood can confirm the SLA tier will remain unchanged for the top-up period (we expect no degradation).

If you can send the two-PO approach + a draft amendment and expected DocuSign flow, we can loop our legal/procurement in and aim to return both POs within 5 business days.

Best,
Lisa
Head of Cloud Ops | AveryTech
From: priyom.das@redwoodinference.com
To: tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 08:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal paperwork + incremental capacity top-up / invoice split (internal)

Tessa / Marissa —

Looping legal and finance shadow items before we send the external docs. Draft plan below: 

- Legal: produce a one-page amendment (exhibit A: capacity ramp and revert schedule; exhibit B: invoice/tranche schedule). Keep no new licensing language, only commitment and billing mechanics.
- Finance: create two invoice SKUs: RDW-BASE-18M and RDW-TOPUP-Q1. Finance needs the exact PO numbering format Avery expects (Lisa, their PO format?).
- Ops: confirm SLA remains at Platinum for top-up window. Ops to confirm in writing so Lisa can forward to legal.

Marissa — can you prepare the DocuSign packet and Azure Private Offer change request template? I will draft the legal language and share it for a quick review.

Thanks,
Priyom
From: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
To: Lisa Huang <lisa.huang@averytech.com>, tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com, priyom.das@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 10:16:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Renewal paperwork + incremental capacity top-up / invoice split

Lisa —

Appreciate the quick clarity. Attaching two templates: a) RDW amendment for Private Offer changes (Word doc) and b) sample PO layout for two POs. We'll populate the fields you flagged.

Key confirmations from our side: 
- SLA: Platinum tier will remain in effect for the duration of the top-up window (no degradation). Ops confirms in writing below.
- DocuSign flow: we will send two DocuSign envelopes — Envelope A will include the 18-month amendment; Envelope B will include the separate top-up PO. Both can be routed to procurement@averytech.com for signature.
- Marketplace acceptance: after signatures we will submit the Azure Private Offer change request; acceptance typically takes 48–72 business hours on Azure once the private offer is updated. We'll flag the HubSpot deal and notify your team when acceptance completes.

I attached the templates and have left the PO numbering field blank for you to fill. Once we have signed docs, we will generate invoices to invoices@averytech.com per your timing.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Renewals Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachments: RDW_Azure_Private_Amendment_Template.docx (draft), RDW_PO_Sample_Template.pdf
From: Lisa Huang <lisa.huang@averytech.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com, priyom.das@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2026 09:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork + incremental capacity top-up / invoice split

Thanks Marissa — received the templates. Procurement has created two POs and scanned them; attaching PO PDFs for your intake.

What we are sending: 
- PO-Avery-2027-Base-000874.pdf (baseline 18-month commitment, effective 2027-01-01)
- PO-Avery-2027-Topup-000875.pdf (Q1 top-up, dated 2027-03-31)

We will sign the DocuSign envelopes after Redwood populates the amendment fields and DocuSign links arrive. Expect AP to approve the scanned POs and then the final signed envelopes thereafter.

Lisa
From: tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com
To: Lisa Huang <lisa.huang@averytech.com>, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, priyom.das@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Renewal paperwork + incremental capacity top-up / invoice split

Lisa — perfect, thank you.

We received the scanned POs in procurement@redwoodinference.com and I just kicked the DocuSign envelopes out (two separate links):
- DocuSign Envelope A: https://www.docusign.com/rdw/accept/abc123 (Amendment for baseline)
- DocuSign Envelope B: https://www.docusign.com/rdw/accept/def456 (Top-up PO)

Operational notes for internal handoff: 
- marissa.cole: please submit the Azure Private Offer change after Envelope A is signed; mark acceptance in HubSpot and set follow-up task for 72 business hours to confirm acceptance.
- priyom.das: finance should ready two invoice templates and confirm SKU mapping RDW-BASE-18M / RDW-TOPUP-Q1 to invoices@averytech.com.
- I will confirm with Ops that the Platinum SLA holds during the top-up, then send a quick note to Lisa to confirm.

Lisa — once you sign both envelopes we will proceed immediately. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Tessa
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

Attachments: Avery_PO_2026Q4.pdf, RDW_Azure_Private_Offer_PO.docx
